summary: Lock the existing wall showcase single-body color behavior with regression coverage. No production behavior changes: wall_showcase_100_2 and wall_showcase_100_3 keep one grouped bodySurface color override, four physical body boards remain one user-selectable color target, and existing BOM, placement, renderer geometry, persistence and catalog identity stay unchanged.

impactAnalysis.notes: Fresh Version2 review confirms the requested capability already exists in production: createShowcaseModuleState owns one bodySurface color, createShowcaseModule exposes one acceptsColor selector, and that selector targets both side boards plus top/bottom boards together. This change adds regression coverage only. No Item identity, BOM, placement, move/rotation, renderer geometry, persistence schema, selection behavior, context menu, catalog or relationship logic is modified. F-025/F-030 and audit remediation are reviewedNotAffected only.

e2e.reason: The production behavior is unchanged, but the existing wall-showcase browser lifecycle and smoke suites are retained as end-to-end regression coverage before merge.

risk.notes: Regression-only change. No production source file is modified.

migration.notes: No state shape, storage schema or persisted project migration is introduced.

rollback: Remove test/showcaseBodyColorRegression.test.js and restore the previous change-contract declaration; production runtime remains untouched.
